camel.summary: The model is a tan chibi camel with a red and rainbow blanket. It is the same animal as the mockup, but the blanket, the muzzle, and the back line have clear differences.
strengths: The large head, the eyes with lashes, and the pointed ears match the mockup.
The long neck, the knee rings, the brown hooves, and the tail tuft match the mockup.
The tan and red palette matches the mockup, and the blanket colors read at 128 px.
issues: The blanket is a tall stack of rainbow layers. It stands up from the back like a fin. Make a flat red drape with ruffled edges that lies on the back, with the rainbow ruffles in one band at the center.
The hump does not show. Add a low hump under the blanket so that the back line rises behind the shoulders.
The muzzle is small and cream. Make a large, round muzzle in the head color with two large nostrils.
The neck is a straight diagonal. Give the neck the mockup curve: up from the chest, then forward under the head.
The hair tuft on the head is one tan knob. Make a group of brown curls.
The walk has small leg swings and no head motion. Increase the stride and add a small head bob.
camel.next: Replace the tall blanket stack with a flat, ruffled red drape on a low hump.

pack-goat.summary: The model is a gray chibi goat with tall tan horns and red and tan pack bags. The horns and the bags match the mockup, but the face and the mane have clear differences.
strengths: The tan bags with red straps and gold rings match the mockup closely.
The ridged horns curl back and read in every sprite direction.
The gray body, the beard, and the black hooves match the mockup.
issues: The face is different. The muzzle is thin and points down like a trunk, and the ears are round. Make a broad, long goat face with a small smile and long ears that hang to the sides.
The eyes are amber with heavy upper lids, and the goat looks tired. Use large white eyes with black pupils and a happy look, as in the mockup.
The mane is a smooth, light gray strip from the head to the back. It reads as a tube. Make a short, shaggy mane on the neck and on the back.
The walk has very small leg swings. Increase the stride and lift the hooves.
From the front, the horns rise almost vertically. Tilt the horns more to the back.
pack-goat.next: Rebuild the head with a broad goat muzzle, long side ears, and large white eyes.

riding-wolf.summary: The model is a gray chibi wolf with a brown saddle and a teal pad. The body and the paws match the mockup, but the face has a different expression and a different color pattern.
strengths: The large head on a short body gives the mockup chibi proportion.
The white socks and the black paws match the mockup and read at 128 px.
The teal pad and the brown leather read as a mount saddle.
issues: The expression is different. The brows press down on the eyes and the mouth is a flat line, so the wolf looks angry. Make large eyes with a calm upper lid and a side smile, as in the mockup.
The cream face mask is missing. Paint the lower half of the face, the cheeks, and the chest cream. Keep the gray on the top of the head.
The muzzle is a white ball that projects from the head, and the cheek tufts look like separate parts. Blend the muzzle into the face and make the cheeks part of the cream mask.
The saddle sits at the center of the back. Move the harness forward, with the chest strap, the ring, and the side bags, as in the mockup.
The tail has no white tip. Paint the tip white.
riding-wolf.next: Change the face to the mockup: a cream lower face, large calm eyes, and a side smile.

riding-lizard.summary: The model is a green chibi lizard with orange stripes, a cream belly, and a brown saddle. It is the same animal as the mockup, but the stance is tall, and the stripes and the saddle are weak.
strengths: The green, orange, and cream palette matches the mockup.
The head with the smile and the large eyes on top reads as friendly.
The walk has a good stride, and the feet stay on the ground.
issues: The legs are long and straight, and the body stands high like a dog. Make the legs short and bent, with the feet out to the sides, and lower the body.
The orange stripes are thin and few. Make wide orange bands across the head, the back, the legs, and the tail.
The saddle is a soft brown pile. Make a clean leather saddle with a stitched edge and one strap with a buckle down the side.
The smile is almost closed. Open the mouth wider and show the red inside, as in the mockup.
The chest has no plates. Add the cream plate lines on the chest.
In the walk, the cream belly paint shows on the inner side of a front leg. Keep the belly paint off the legs.
riding-lizard.next: Lower the body on short, bent legs with the feet out to the sides.

dragon-mount.summary: The model is a green chibi dragon with yellow horns, orange wings, and a brown saddle. It is the same creature as the mockup, but the body, the neck, and the face are clearly different.
strengths: The yellow horns, the cheek fins, and the yellow tail spikes match the mockup.
The walk has a good stride, and the wings stay attached.
The horns and the wings read in every sprite direction.
issues: The body is long and the neck points forward. Make the body short and compact, and hold the neck upright with the head above the chest.
The face is different. The snout is long and flat, the eyes sit on the sides, and the smile is a small line. Make a round head with large front eyes, orange irises, and a wide smile.
The belly plates are faint. Make bold cream plates from the chin to the belly.
The cream paint bleeds onto the legs as soft patches. Keep the cream on the chest and the belly only.
The saddle is small and hides under the wing. Make the saddle larger, with a red seat and a buckle strap on the side.
The wings have a green frame and orange skin. Make the wings smaller, with yellow skin and brown edges, as in the mockup.
dragon-mount.next: Shorten the body and lift the neck so that the head sits upright above the chest.

gryphon-mount.summary: The model is an orange chibi gryphon with a yellow beak, raised wings, and a blue saddle. The colors and the harness match the mockup, but the beak, the head, and the expression have clear differences.
strengths: The blue saddle pad, the brown chest strap, and the blue gem match the mockup.
The orange and yellow palette and the yellow ears match the mockup.
The raised wings and the tail read in every sprite direction.
issues: The beak is thin and points down, and the gryphon looks worried. Make a large, round beak with a smile line and a calm, confident brow, as in the mockup.
The head and the neck are smooth. Add the feather crest on the head and sculpted feathers on the neck.
The feet have long, sharp talons. Make round brown toe caps, as in the mockup.
The tail is long and thin with a round ball at the end. Make a short, thick, braided tail with a fan of feathers at the tip.
gryphon-mount.next: Rebuild the beak as a large, round, smiling beak, and give the brow a confident shape.
